provenance.description: Advisory fixture-affinity estimates from fresh setup/call/teardown records. Latest successful node observations replace earlier observations; failed or unexecuted nodes retain their previous observation. Group consumers retain call/teardown costs plus one maximum observed setup charge assigned to the first sorted consumer. Failed nodes remain timing observations, never reusable test evidence.

new_test_fallback.description: Four new cache/count nodes use focused macOS3.12.14 observations as explicitly provisional costs on every platform until hosted measurements replace them. These estimates never prove execution or performance.
